description: Retrieve a drawing saved by MCPaint using the imageId supplied by the app or user. Returns a normal MCP image content block so you can see the image even when app-to-chat image messages are unsupported. Saved images expire after 24 hours. The client must support images in tool results. Do not invent or guess image IDs.

imageId.description: The imageId from a saved MCPaint reference.

name: get_saved_image
title: View a saved MCPaint image
